fomod.Name: Norden UI - Edge Colours
fomod.Author: recolour of Norden UI by Nithog
fomod.Description: Norden UI wearing Edge UI's colours. Norden's layout, icons and animations are unchanged; its neutral ramp is remapped onto Edge UI's measured palette and its gold text onto Edge's cream/gold. Requires Norden UI - install this after it. This installer mirrors Norden UI's own: pick the same options you picked there.
